name: profile-availability-service-mode
objective: Close Captain profile/docs/rating/tier, persisted availability and absence behavior, and service/store-courier mode without allowing local UI state to weaken server-owned delivery requirements.
truthOwner: DSH/Workforce own operational availability, absence/accreditation and assignment requirements; local Captain UI state is presentation/input only.

tasks.objective: Implement canonical Captain availability and absence readback
tasks.currentProblem: The live availability control is not wired; mutation attempts fail and state never becomes available.
tasks.requiredChange: Find or create the DSH-owned authenticated Captain availability contract and persistence according to Product Truth, bind the app control to mutation plus canonical readback, handle break/planned-leave/absence semantics through the real owner, and make retries/version conflicts fail closed.
tasks.targetState: Captain can intentionally change allowed availability states and both app and dispatch read the same persisted truth.
tasks.action: Trace current backend capability, implement the missing canonical mutation/readback, bind UI, add persistence/concurrency tests and remove local-only remnants.
mustNotChange: Do not keep local availability as truth.
Do not mark available when mutation/readback is ambiguous.
Do not expand generic HR scope.
acceptanceCriteria: App and dispatch read the same value/version.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused availability adapter/persistence change without restoring fake local availability.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused availability/readback commit with DB evidence.

tasks.objective: Make profile/docs/rating/service mode truthful and non-authoritative locally
tasks.currentProblem: Local service/store-courier mode can alter PoD and exception presentation while profile/doc/tier surfaces may diverge from canonical owners.
tasks.requiredChange: Bind profile/docs/rating/tier to Workforce/DSH canonical readbacks; census AMN and store-courier reachability; remove unsupported/dead paths or govern them through explicit assignment/service policy. No local toggle may reduce proof/custody/exception requirements.
tasks.targetState: Reachable account/service-mode screens show canonical Captain truth and local state cannot weaken server rules.
tasks.action: Trace account callers and service-mode policy, replace static/local truth, move requirements to server-owned assignment policy and delete obsolete branches after proof.
mustNotChange: Local mode may not bypass PoD/custody/exception rules.
Do not preserve unreachable modes without callers.
Do not create another profile owner.
acceptanceCriteria: Unsupported modes are removed or blocked.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused presentation changes while preserving server-owned requirements.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused profile/service-mode cleanup after reachability census.
